instructions: Import 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in your main CSS or HTML.
Headings (H1, H2) must use Outfit with tight tracking (`tracking-tight`).
Body text must use IBM Plex Sans for maximum readability.
Data points, URLs, risk scores, and technical readouts MUST use JetBrains Mono to reinforce the cybersecurity terminal aesthetic.

surface_styles.glassmorphism: Used for the login card and sticky header. Apply `backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10` to maintain deep contrast and optical clarity.
surface_styles.grid_borders: Used for stats and panels. Expose the structural skeleton using `border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02]`.
surface_styles.tactical_shadows: Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or subtle glowing box-shadows matching the status colors for the results card.

visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, crisp interactions. Inputs should have a subtle ring on focus (`focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/30`). Stagger list items in the reasons lists.

layouts.login_page: Center-aligned glassmorphism card floating over the dark abstract network background. Ensure the background image has a dark overlay (`bg-black/80`) to ensure text readability.
layouts.dashboard: Bento-style grid. 1-column on mobile. On desktop, asymmetrical 2-column layout: Left column (col-span-5) for Input Form, Right column (col-span-7) for Results and SHAP Analysis. Use generous gap (`gap-8`).

components.navigation: Persistent top nav with the App Logo/Name and User Profile/Logout action. Must have `border-b border-white/10` and `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md`.
components.input_form: Minimalist and tactical. Dark inputs (`bg-black/40`), thin borders (`border-white/10`). The Submit button should be stark white with black text (`bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200`) or dynamically inherit the primary accent.
components.result_card: A highly structured technical panel. Display the Risk Score as a massive percentage using JetBrains Mono. The Verdict badge MUST map to the status colors (Safe=Green, Suspicious=Yellow, Phishing=Red).
components.reasons_lists: URL and Message reasons should be presented as bulleted lists with small semantic icons (lucide-react: ShieldAlert, ShieldCheck).
components.recommendation_box: A prominent, distinctly colored call-out box at the bottom of the result panel to provide plain-language safety advice.
components.testing: All interactive and informational elements (buttons, inputs, verdicts, scores) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="risk-score"`).

image_urls.description: Abstract blue network nodes. Apply as full-screen background for the Login Page. MUST include a heavy black overlay to maintain contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a top 1% cybersecurity app called TrustLens. Execute a 'Tactical Minimalism' dark aesthetic.
The app uses .js/.jsx extensions for React. Provide code accordingly.
Implement the login page with the provided abstract network background. Overlay it with black at 80% opacity.
On the main dashboard, build a responsive 2-column layout. The input form on the left, and the prediction results on the right.
The API call POST to /api/predict MUST include a loading state that disables the submit button and shows a scanner/spinner.
Color code the entire Result Card (badges, borders, glows) dynamically based on the predicted verdict (Safe=green, Suspicious=yellow, Phishing=red).
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays; always use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur.
Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom font families and the deep dark colors specified.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left-alignment for dense, technical data.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to match the dark tactical aesthetic.
